name: Love+Laby
source:
A planet similar to the Earth of the 18th century. There is no electricity there, because there is magic and alchemy. Weird monsters become active and attack human communities. Main character is a warrior who stands up to protect these people.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-september-2006-pp.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一颗类似18世纪地球的行星。那里没有电力，因为魔法与炼金术取而代之。奇异怪物变得活跃，袭击人类聚居地。主人公是一名战士，挺身保护这些人。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-september-2006-pp.html]vndbreview[/url]]
